# Nexus Apps

> App development company in Berlin. Nexus Apps builds and maintains iOS, Android and web applications for businesses and founders.

Nexus Apps builds and operates six in-house iOS apps.

## Development services

- [iOS app development](https://nexusapps.co/services/ios-app-development/): Bring your iPhone app from its first screens to App Store submission. We design the interface, build the iOS features and test the release on the devices your customers use.
- [Mobile app development](https://nexusapps.co/services/mobile-app-development/): Build an iOS or Android app for your customers or team. We work with you on the scope, interface and development through testing and store submission.
- [Web app development](https://nexusapps.co/services/web-app-development/): Build a web application for your customers or team. We plan the workflows, design a responsive interface and develop the backend and integrations your product needs.
- [MVP development](https://nexusapps.co/services/mvp-development/): A minimum viable product (MVP) is a first release focused on testing a product idea with real users. We agree on what you need to learn, choose the essential features and build a mobile or web release.
- [App-Entwicklung Berlin](https://nexusapps.co/de/app-entwicklung-berlin/): German-language overview of app development in Berlin. Project communication is in English.
- [App laten maken](https://nexusapps.co/nl/app-laten-maken/): Dutch-language overview for companies in the Netherlands. The studio is based in Berlin; project communication is in English.

## Work with the studio

- [Our process](https://nexusapps.co/process/): Product discovery, scope, design, development, testing, launch and ongoing maintenance.
- [About us](https://nexusapps.co/about/): The company, its development approach and in-house product background.
- [Contact](https://nexusapps.co/contact/): Discuss a mobile app, web product or MVP. Email hello@nexusapps.co with your idea, intended users, existing materials and timing.

## In-house iOS portfolio

- [Our apps](https://nexusapps.co/apps/): Six products built, published and maintained by Nexus Apps.
- [Visual LabX](https://nexusapps.co/apps/visuallabx/): Layer film filters and effects or retouch a portrait with Visual LabX, a photo editor for iPhone.
- [Photo CamAI](https://nexusapps.co/apps/photocamai/): Enhance a photo in one tap with Photo CamAI. Its AI analyzes the image on your iPhone.
- [Wallpapers Neo](https://nexusapps.co/apps/wallpapers/): Browse iPhone wallpapers by style, save favorites and add your own text before saving a background.
- [Retro Cam Neo](https://nexusapps.co/apps/retrocamneo/): Preview vintage film looks as you shoot on iPhone, with adjustable grain, warmth and exposure.
- [Clear Wave Pro](https://nexusapps.co/apps/clearwave/): Test left and right speaker channels, run sound-based cleaning modes and check ambient noise on iPhone.
- [ASO Rocket](https://nexusapps.co/apps/asorocket/): Research App Store keywords on iPhone, organize saved terms and copy a keyword string for App Store Connect.

- [App policies](https://nexusapps.co/app-policies/): Original app privacy policies and terms, including documents using the former iScreen AI Wallpapers name.
